purpose: 2026-10-10 DFT-informed campaign, S6-13, S6-15, S6-23. Generated by analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/s6s7_plans.py; entries resolved from the sealed record analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/profile/s6s7_record_A58.json (register A58).
global_rules: Sequential only: python scripts/run_campaign.py <plan> (C10 plans refuse --workers != 1). Every launch counts, failed or not. Hard cap 200: config/solver.yaml max_launches 260 (= 60 used before C10 + 200) and a C10 label counter (c10_* run IDs in RUN_INDEX <= 200) in run_campaign.py.

run_campaign.py (C10 plans) never re-launches an entry whose label already has a RUN_INDEX row, from this or any other C10 plan (MIN10 vs stage plans): a successful earlier launch is reused, a failed one is reported; --retry ID spends a new (reserve) launch on purpose.
Model file for every entry: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml" (V3 + the overrides = the same solver statements as V2 + the overrides, check_v3_equivalence.py).
After any code change: python analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/regress_all_decks.py must print "unexpected differences 0" before the next launch.

run_campaign.py records a failed launch and CONTINUES (this plan declares no gates); it stops automatically only at the launch budget / C10 cap. S6 / S7 have no stop rule (CAMPAIGN_DESIGN l.334-336): every result is reported; a failed launch is kept, never retried automatically (a repair only from the reserved six by a logged decision). Until the A58 read-out, the console and RUN_INDEX are read for state fields only (id, run_id, status, error; exit_code, converged, elapsed_s).
stop_rules: Register A58: campaign_C10_S6_b3 runs S6-13, S6-15, S6-23 in this order and stops; no stop rule (CAMPAIGN_DESIGN l.334-336). Next batch only after prelaunch_gate_c10_j.py exits 0 naming it; no launch whose start could fall after 2026-10-16T10:00Z (A58 (f)).
stop_rules_enforced_by: main session (manual); run_campaign.py enforces the launch budget and C10 cap and refuses runnable=false plans; no gates
register_amendment: A58 (2026-10-16; S6 / S7 execution entries resolved at the S4c frozen model, PA-19 v3 section 4 allocation at the S5 -> S6 point, J gate; no Codex review, D-63): invoke only after A58 and its decision row are logged and the sealed record is committed, with the go for THIS launch (the hook asks the user), immediately after prelaunch_gate_c10_j.py has exited 0 naming this plan
